sentence_stem: I cannot come to the party on Friday, because
full_sentence: I cannot come to the party on Friday, because I have to work late.
acceptable_variants: my boss needs me that evening.
I am busy at my job that night.

options.why_wrong: This gives a fact about the party, but it is not a reason why the writer cannot come.
This is a positive opinion. It does not explain why the writer cannot come, so it does not complete the 'because' clause.
This gives the time of the party, not the cause that 'because' needs.

explanation: After 'because', we need a clause that gives the reason for the first part of the sentence. Ukrainian speakers sometimes add a general comment instead of a specific reason, so the reason must answer why the action is not possible.
translation: Я не можу прийти на вечірку в п'ятницю, тому що мені треба працювати допізна.
